🔴 **[10-28 05:41 Beijing] Banks plan to issue up to $21 billion in debt for Broadcom's $63 billion chip financing deal for Anthropic**  
Multiple banks including Bank of America, Citigroup, and Morgan Stanley are planning to sell up to approximately $21 billion in investment-grade bonds as early as early 2027 as part of a $63 billion financing package led by Broadcom to help fund AI developer Anthropic PBC's chip needs. The banks will provide approximately $42 billion in loans, with up to half the funding expected to be refinanced in the US investment-grade corporate debt market in Q1 2027.  
_News · Wallstreetcn · Broadcom, Anthropic · [Source](https://wallstreetcn.com/livenews/3187937)_

🔴 **[10-28 04:25 Beijing] Broadcom arranges financing for custom AI accelerator-based AI racks; assumes up to $43B residual value guarantee**  
SEC filing shows Broadcom has arranged financing with financial partners for AI racks based on custom AI accelerators. The company provides residual value support to special-purpose vehicles (SPVs), with maximum potential liability under the guarantee arrangement of approximately $43 billion. The company assumes up to $43 billion AI rack residual-value guarantee, covering 72.5% of customer lease amounts.  
_News · Sina · Broadcom · [Source](https://finance.sina.cn/7x24/2026-10-28/detail-iniwtiak3491475.d.html)_

🔴 **[10-28 04:22 Beijing] Seagate Q1 revenue $4.2B +60% YoY beats estimates; guides FY revenue $48B; stock falls 7% post-market**  
Seagate Technology Q1 2026 revenue $4.2 billion, up 60% year-on-year, beat consensus $4.11 billion. Non-GAAP diluted EPS $7.68 vs. $2.61 prior year, beat consensus $7.39. Q2 2026 guidance: revenue $4.8 billion. FY 2026 guidance: revenue $4.8 billion ± $1 billion, non-GAAP EPS $9.20 ± $0.20. Stock fell 7%+ post-market; Western Digital fell 2%+.  
_News · CLS · Seagate Technology (STX), Western Digital · [Source](https://api3.cls.cn/share/article/2517187?os=web&sv=8.4.6&app=CailianpressWeb)_

🔴 **[10-28 04:17 Beijing] NXP Q3 revenue $3.79B +19% YoY, guides Q4 EPS $4.14–4.58 vs consensus $4.36; announces $5B buyback**  
NXP Semiconductors reported Q3 2026 revenue of $3.79 billion, up 19% year-on-year (8% sequentially). Non-GAAP gross margin 58.6%, operating margin 37.1%, diluted EPS $4.20 vs. $3.11 prior year. Free cash flow $1.21 billion (31.9% of revenue). Q4 2026 guidance: revenue $37.5–39.5 billion [note: appears to be total guidance, not quarterly], non-GAAP diluted EPS $4.14–4.58 (consensus $4.36), gross margin 58.5–59.5% (consensus 59%). Capital return $359 million in Q3 (dividends $256M, buybacks $103M). Company announced $5 billion share repurchase authorization. CEO cited accelerating contributions from automotive and industrial business plus continued momentum in data center infrastructure; significant long-term growth opportunities from software-defined vehicles, data center infrastructure and Trusted Physical AI applications.  
_News · CLS · NXP Semiconductors (NXPI) · [Source](https://api3.cls.cn/share/article/2517186?os=web&sv=8.4.6&app=CailianpressWeb)_

**[10-28 01:48 Beijing] Anduril Industries and Qualcomm plan to produce BlueChip rugged laptops with 90% US/allied supply chain**  
Defense technology startup Anduril Industries Inc. and Qualcomm are collaborating to produce laptops designed and assembled in the US, aiming to rebuild manufacturing processes that have largely shifted overseas. The two companies launched a new product line called BlueChip, intended to supply critical industries including government, defense, and public safety, with the goal of establishing an end-to-end US supply chain. Anduril has produced functional prototype BlueChip laptops with 90% of components from US or allied-nation suppliers; currently seeking sources for remaining components including display panels to achieve 100% domestic US sourcing.  
_News · Wallstreetcn · Anduril Industries, Qualcomm · [Source](https://wallstreetcn.com/livenews/3187863)_

## Power & Datacenter Infrastructure (7)

🔴 **[10-28 06:28 Beijing] AI datacenter electricity demand drives gas turbine supply-chain opportunities as orders accelerate**  
AI datacenter construction is accelerating, driving increased demand for power supply equipment and attracting attention to gas turbine supply-chain investment opportunities. Recent developments include: Jerry Inc. (杰瑞股份) advancing large orders and capacity construction; China Superconductor Technology (中超控股) expanding component partnerships; Turbine Technology (汽轮科技) accelerating commercial deployment of its independent gas turbine. Analysts note that the mismatch between growing AI electricity demand in North America and a lengthy grid expansion cycle creates opportunities for on-site gas turbine generation. With overseas equipment supply tight, domestic enterprises with proprietary technology, production capacity, and delivery advantages are well-positioned to expand into overseas markets. Key factors to monitor include order fulfillment, capacity release, and overseas project execution.  
_News · CLS · Jerry Inc., China Superconductor Technology, Turbine Technology · [Source](https://api3.cls.cn/share/article/2517211?os=web&sv=8.4.6&app=CailianpressWeb)_

🔴 **[10-28 11:10 Beijing] SK Hynix: DRAM and HBM capacity nearly sold out through 2029**  
On 28 October, SK Hynix stated at its earnings call that through 2029, DRAM and HBM (high-bandwidth memory) capacity is essentially sold out, with significantly improved long-term sales outlook. The company completed next-generation HBM4E sample shipments in Q2, with HBM4 development and certification tracking to customer timelines.  
_News · Sina · SK Hynix · [Source](https://finance.sina.cn/7x24/2026-10-28/detail-iniwtxxy6622800.d.html)_

🔴 **[10-28 11:04 Beijing] SK Hynix CEO: DRAM and HBM capacity nearly sold out over next three years, visibility significantly improved**  
SK Hynix CEO Kuh Lim said at Wednesday's earnings call: "Already-confirmed LTA orders, combined with current negotiations with customers, mean that through 2029—the next three years—our DRAM and HBM capacity is virtually sold out. Orders under negotiation are based on customers' clear procurement plans with high closing probability. Overall, medium to long-term sales visibility has improved significantly." The company also completed HBM4E samples in Q2, with HBM4 development and certification on track with customer timelines.  
_News · CLS · SK Hynix · [Source](https://api3.cls.cn/share/article/2517470?os=web&sv=8.4.6&app=CailianpressWeb)_

🔴 **[10-28 09:13 Beijing] SK Hynix: HBM4, HBM3E yields exceed targets; focusing on production efficiency to meet strong customer demand**  
SK Hynix stated on earnings call: yields currently very stable. Maintains industry-leading yields across both fabs and backend processes. Backend yields span full process, not just bump stacking, KGSD testing. HBM4 yield already exceeded original targets; guidance raised. HBM3E yield also exceeded expectations; now focusing on production efficiency to meet strong customer demand.  
_News · Tonghuashun · SK Hynix · [Source](https://news.10jqka.com.cn/20261028/c681167507.shtml)_

🔴 **[10-28 07:28 Beijing] SK Hynix Q3 2026: Operating profit $6.25B +632% YoY, operating margin 80%; revenue $7.84B +328% YoY**  
SK Hynix Q3 2026 results: Revenue 104.62 trillion won, +32% QoQ and +328% YoY (consensus 98.96t won); operating profit 83.33 trillion won (+38% QoQ, +632% YoY; consensus 77.5t won); net profit 39.78 trillion won (+216% YoY); operating margin 80%, net margin 38%. Revenue and operating profit both hit record quarterly highs; revenue exceeded 100 trillion won for first time. Results driven by strong AI storage demand lifting prices for HBM4, server DDR5 and enterprise SSD (eSSD). Paid special dividend of 20,000 won/share from Kioxia investment proceeds. Announced 2026 shareholder return plan of 100 trillion won total: min. 30t won cash dividend, min. 60t won buyback/cancellation.  
_News · Wallstreetcn · SK Hynix · [Source](https://wallstreetcn.com/livenews/3187965)_

🔴 **[10-28 06:33 Beijing] ASMPT Q3 2026: Record bookings, TCB C2S orders surge on AI datacenter demand, photonics revenue hits record**  
ASMPT Limited reported Q3 2026 revenue of HK$5.25bn (US$669.2m), up 6.3% QoQ and 48.7% YoY. Record group bookings of HK$8.85bn (US$1.128bn), up 24.7% QoQ and 137.9% YoY, driven by Thermo Compression Bonding (TCB), SMT products, and Photonics. Advanced Packaging segment saw strong demand: TCB chip-to-substrate (C2S) orders reached record highs from AI datacenter customers and OSAT partners; chip-to-wafer (C2W) saw repeat orders from leading IDM for advanced CPUs. Memory TCB orders linked to HBM4 rollout; company developing next-generation TCB solutions for superior throughput and yield. Photonics bookings and revenue hit record levels, driven by 800G, 1.6T and next-generation optical module production ramps for AI-related datacenters. SEMI Mainstream supported by AI-related demand in power management and AI server boards. SMT achieved third consecutive quarter of record bookings with strong demand for AI server boards and optical transceivers. Adjusted gross margin rose to 42.9%, adjusted operating profit up 8.9% QoQ and 379.2% YoY. Q4 2026 revenue guidance: US$670-730m (up 4.6% QoQ, 37.5% YoY at midpoint).  
_Filing · HKEX filing · ASMPT (0522.HK) · [Source](https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/1028/2026102800023.pdf)_

🔴 **[10-28 01:01 Beijing] ASM International Q3 2026: net profit 308.1 million euros, beats forecast; Q4 guidance 1.23 billion euros; achieves 2030 sales target three years early**  
Dutch chipmaking equipment manufacturer ASM International reported Q3 2026 net profit of 308.1 million euros versus analyst consensus 302.3 million euros. Q3 sales 116 million euros beat consensus 110 million euros. Q3 operating margin 32.7% versus 32% consensus; Q3 gross margin 52% versus 50.8% consensus. Q4 revenue guidance €1.23 billion (±5% range), approximately $1.37 billion, beating analyst consensus €1.18 billion. Expects 2027 revenue to exceed €5.7 billion at fixed exchange rates, achieving the original 2030 sales target three years early; LSEG-surveyed analysts previously expected 2027 revenue €5.41 billion. Degroot Petercam analyst Michael Roeg called this performance a 'triple beat' driven by stronger-than-expected Q3 sales and quarterly/annual outlook. Company on track to exceed prior guidance for full-year 2026.  
_News · Wallstreetcn · ASM International · [Source](https://wallstreetcn.com/livenews/3187848)_

🔴 **[10-28] ASML CEO at crossroads: EUV demand surges but US export controls tighten; faces geopolitical rift in world's largest incremental market**  
ASML faces strategic dilemma: unprecedented EUV demand from AI; yet US controls tighten, leaving it caught in world's largest growth market—China. ASML CFO Roger Dassen called MATCH Act a "bad idea"; if passed, will accelerate China's self-reliant tech competition. MATCH Act (introduced April 2, 2026) would ban all ASML immersion DUV lithography tool sales to China, including spare parts, calibration, support. One Dutch analyst likened it to "selling car but banning gas and repairs." Bill passed key committee in April; Trump administration has not taken formal position. Fouquet's stance consistently draws clear line between "obeying law" and "opposing over-blocking."  
_News · Caixin · ASML · [Source](https://database.caixin.com/2026-10-28/102498058.html)_
